policy.scope: Diagnostic-only feasibility of the unchanged captured three-output topology and complete template domains. Not an original-budget control result.
policy.solver: OR-Tools CP-SAT, exactly one Boolean per distinct statically legal complete path, lazy exact cell-occupancy exclusions
invariants: Enumerate every frozen domain candidate; do not shorten domains or change geometry.
Collapse only identical normalized complete paths belonging to the same obligation, retaining a representative frozen candidate ID.
Cross-check static rejection against independent expanded-cell geometry; disagreement invalidates the diagnostic, never proves infeasibility.
Collision cuts exclude only simultaneous selections occupying a cell they cannot legally share under exact endpoint ownership.
A relaxed-model witness is not accepted until all selected paths pass independent complete geometry checks.
Only CP-SAT INFEASIBLE after complete domain enumeration and sound exclusions proves frozen-family infeasibility. Any diagnostic limit is UNKNOWN.

Any witness is separately replayed through the existing construction/audit path with exact problem equality, in a temporary extracted archive. It cannot open production or downstream experiment gates.
